ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 65-70% high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels dominating the medial and distal lobe regions, with 30-35% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels concentrated at the peduncle base and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized low-intensity anchor-shaped mass at the peduncle junction branching into radiate striations; thick, continuous dark banding (50-100 pixel width) along the entire trailing edge; isolated low-intensity circular punctations (diameter 5-15 pixels) scattered across both high-intensity medial fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 52 degrees; longitudinal depth extends approximately 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serration profile along the entire trailing edge; peak-to-valley variance of 8-25 pixels; most pronounced jaggedness occurs at the mid-lobe positions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral concave curvature at the distal tips transitioning to a moderate convex curve towards the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular black rings (annular scars) located on the mid-left lobe and the lower-right medial region, consistent with prior barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, low-contrast vertical linear disruptions visible on the right lobe high-intensity field, oriented roughly 80 degrees relative to the trailing edge horizontal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive colonization of live barnacles (Coronula diadema) clustered on both the extreme left and right distal tips; significant circular black scarring across the white pigmentation fields.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'salt-and-pepper' mottled transition zone between the black central base and the white distal lobe fields.
